## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 353 captures during July 2026. Activity was maintained across the reporting period, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded capture total provides the overall measure of activity for the site and month. No further adjustment to the reported total has been made.

## Image quality

There were 18 ungradable captures. This represented an ungradable rate of 5.1 per cent for the reporting period. The result should be considered alongside the total capture activity when reviewing image quality at West Gate Eye Clinic. The ungradable activity has been reported separately from the overall capture figure to support routine monitoring and follow-up.

## Grading

Grading identified 120 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. These results provide the main grading measures for July 2026 and should be reviewed through the usual site processes. Overall, the report records activity, image quality, and grading outcomes for West Gate Eye Clinic in a consistent format.
